_readme: Rules ARIA uses to decide what each finding needs, with no code change. The advisory data itself (affected products, fixed releases, workarounds) is fetched automatically from NetApp for every advisory a finding refers to; this file only says how to read it. Edit and reload the page (no restart). A copy in data/resolution_rules.json overrides this file. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively; the first class whose pattern matches a product name wins. firmwareKnownIssues: known issues of a firmware version, by model family and version (exact list or minimum); shown beside the firmware drift list. upgradePathKnownIssues: known issues of one upgrade path (from a release, to a release line), shown with that path in the upgrade roadmap.

appliesTo._note: Which product classes are software or firmware of a system in each family. A finding whose advisory lists none of them is not applicable to that system.

textRules._note: When Active IQ and the advisory give no fix, the first rule whose pattern matches the finding's title or text decides the action. Add rules here for new kinds of finding.
textRules.summary: Plan a hardware refresh: this platform is past end of availability, so check its end-of-support date and keep a support contract in place until it is replaced

firmwareKnownIssues.summary: The BMC can report 'heartbeat stopped', which leads to sp.ipmi.lost.shutdown and an emergency node shutdown (an HA takeover event)
firmwareKnownIssues.note: NetApp keeps the fixed release behind the support login, so confirm it in the KB. Before a planned BMC update, confirm HA health with 'storage failover show'.
firmwareKnownIssues.source: NetApp KB CFBMC-8277 (updated 2026-10-04), recorded in the NetApp Reference Library on 2026-10-08

firmwareKnownIssues.summary: The BMC can reboot after a hardware watchdog timeout
firmwareKnownIssues.note: NetApp keeps the fixed release behind the support login, so confirm it in the KB.
firmwareKnownIssues.source: NetApp KB CFBMC-6454 (updated 2026-10-06), recorded in the NetApp Reference Library on 2026-10-08

firmwareKnownIssues.summary: After an AC power cycle the BMC can boot its backup image (for example 15.95P1); that is not a newer production version than the current one
firmwareKnownIssues.note: Check the installed and backup images before judging the system as ahead of the recommended version.
firmwareKnownIssues.source: NetApp KB CFBMC-2358, recorded in the NetApp Reference Library on 2026-10-08

upgradePathKnownIssues.summary: During an automated non-disruptive upgrade from 9.16.1P1 to 9.19.1, giveback can fail repeatedly after an HA RDMA queue-pair reject (code 38)
upgradePathKnownIssues.note: If giveback keeps failing, stop, stay in takeover and open a support case.
upgradePathKnownIssues.source: NetApp KB CONTAP-799924 (2026-09-22), recorded in the NetApp Reference Library on 2026-10-08
